CITY OF SAN GABRIEL
  CITY COUNCIL
  REGULAR MEETING AGENDA

  Tuesday, May 4, 2021 - 6:30 P.M.

  City Hall Council Chamber
  425 South Mission Drive
  San Gabriel, California 91776

  Teleconference into the meeting.
  Chin Ho Liao  Mark Lazzaretto

Pursuant to State and County Directives, San Gabriel City Hall is closed to the public and physical access
to the meeting has been suspended. To provide members of the public access to the meeting and an
opportunity to comment on items on and off the Agenda, the following opportunities have been
established:

Public Comments

Please email all public comments to cityclerk@sgch.org and include the following on the subject line of
your email: the section (Public Comment, Consent, Public Hearing, Continued Business, New Business) and
Item Number you are commenting on. The Clerk will read public comments into the record for up to the
three-minute limit. Words that would disrupt the meeting, including profanity, obscenity, and
discriminatory language, will not be read.
Example: PUBLIC COMMENT: New Business Item A
Watch the Meeting Online
Live broadcasts of the meetings are available using the following link:
City Council Meeting Videos
Spectrum cable: Live streaming on Channel 3, Public Access Channel.

  All items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and

  The minutes are a record of the official actions taken at the City Council
  meeting.

  B. MATERIAL DEMANDS

  The most recent Material Demands from the Finance Department are

  2
City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – May 4, 2021
   Recommended Action: Approval.

  C. COUNTYWIDE HOUSEHOLD HAZARDOUS WASTE COLLECTION
  PROGRAM SITING LIABILITY AGREEMENT WITH LOS ANGELES COUNTY

  The County of Los Angeles and the Los Angeles County Sanitation District
  have reserved May 29, 2021 to host an annual Household Hazardous and
  Electronic Waste collection event at the Mission Playhouse Parking Lot in San
  Gabriel. The event will accept qualifying waste from participants who show
  proof of Los Angeles County residency from 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute
  the Countywide Household Hazardous Waste Collection Program Siting
  Liability Agreement.

  5. PUBLIC HEARING – None.

  6. CONTINUED BUSINESS – None.

  7. NEW BUSINESS

  A. UPDATE ON RETAIL LANDSCAPE IN SAN GABRIEL

  COVID-19 has affected and changed many industries, including the local retail
  industry in San Gabriel. This staff report provides an update on the City’s
  existing retail landscape, data on the impacts of the pandemic on the City’s
  sales tax, and the proactive efforts in place for the new and expanded retail
  spaces coming on line.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file this update on the
  retail landscape in San Gabriel, and provide any feedback or direction.

  8. PUBLIC COMMENT

  9. CITY MANAGER’S REPORT

  10. COUNCIL COMMENTS AND CONFERENCE/MEETING REPORTS

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – May 4, 2021

  to report on conferences and/or meetings they have attended.

  11. CLOSED SESSION – None.

  12. ADJOURNMENT

  The next regular City Council meeting will be held on Tuesday, May 18, 2021, at

MINUTES OF MAY 4, 2021
  REGULAR MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL CITY COUNCIL

I  CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Liao called the regular meeting of the San Gabriel City Council to order at 6:35 P.M .
  on Tuesday, May 4, 2021, with all Council Members and staff participating by
  teleconference.

  ROLL CALL

  Council Members Present:  John R. Harrington, Denise Menchaca, Jason Pu, Vice
  Mayor Tony Ding, and Mayor Chin Ho Liao.
  Council Members Absent:  None.
  Staff Members Present:  City Manager Mark Lazzaretto, Assistant City
  Manager/Community Development Director Armine
  Chaparyan, Assistant City Attorney Lloyd Pilchen,
  Community  Services/Interim  M ission  Playhouse
  Director Rebecca Perez, Police Chief Eugene Harris,
  Chief City Clerk Sharon Clark, Public Works Director/City

I  Engineer Greg de Vinck, Fire Chief Steven Wallace,
  Human Resources/Risk Management Director Edward
  Macias, Finance Director William Kaholokula, and
  Assistant City Clerk Marilyn Bonus.

  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Council Member Harrington.

  ANNOUNCEMENTS

  Chief City Clerk Clark provided information for the public on how to view the meeting and
  submit comments, and how to request meeting agendas.

  1. APPROVAL OF AGENDA ORDER

  A motion was made by Council Member Menchaca, seconded by Vice Mayor Ding, to
  approve the agenda order.

I  Motion carried by a vote of 5-0 as follows:

  AYES:  HARRINGTON, MENCHACA, PU, DING, LIAO
  NOES:  NONE
  ABSTAIN :  NONE
  ABSENT:  NONE

  CLOSED SESSION REPORT

  CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR (GOVERNMENT CODE §54957.6)

  CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING MINUTES  Page 1 of 4  May 4, 2021
   City Negotiators - City Manager Lazzaretto, City Attorney Lemieux, and Human
  Resources/Risk Management Director Macias, Labor Relations Counsel Steve Filarsky.
  Regarding the following Employee Organizations - San Gabriel Police Officers' Association,
  San Gabriel Police Management Group, San Gabriel Firefighters' Association, San Gabriel Fire
  Management Group and all Unrepresented Employees.

  Assistant City Attorney Pilchen announced that in the preceding special meeting, no final
  reportable action was taken on the closed session item.

I  2. PRESENTATIONS

  A. RECOGNITION OF RETIRING LOS ANGELES COUNTY LIBRARIAN JULIE
  SORENSON

  Mayor Liao made the presentation.

  B. PROCLAMATION FOR NATIONAL HISTORIC PRESERVATION MONTH

  Mayor Liao made the presentation.

  C. COVID-19 BRIEFING

  Presentations were made by Fire Chief Wallace and Police Ch ief Harris.

  City Manager Lazzaretto led a discussion on re -opening City Hall and resuming
  in - person City Council meetings. There was a consensus of the City Council to
  agendize the re -opening discussion for the next regular City Council meeting in

I  order to consider the latest State legislation at that time.

  3. PUBLIC COMMENT

  Pam Petievich, Co- President of the San Gabriel Friends of the Library (SGFOL),
  provided comments on behalf of herself and Irene Chapman, Co - President of the
  SGFOL, congratulating Julie Sorenson on her retirement as San Gabriel Library's
  Director.

  Senya Lubisich, resident, provided comments thanking the City Council for the
  Preservation Month Proclamation and requesting the highlighting of San Gabriel
  family-owned businesses which have served the community for more than 50 years.

  Martin E. Delgado, Community Library Manager, provided comments announcing the
  reopening of the San Gabriel Library on Monday, May 10, 2021, for select in - person
  service.

  Tasha Wahi, resident, provided comments expressing safety concerns related to the
  Adelyn Stormwater Capture Project.

I  4. CONSENT CALENDAR

  A motion was made by Council Member Pu, seconded by Council Member Menchaca,
  to approve Consent Calendar Items 4A - 4C as presented.

  Motion approved Consent Calendar Items 4A - 4C as presented, by a vote of 5-0 as
  follows:

  AYES:  HARRINGTON, MENCHACA, PU, DING, LIAO
  NOES:  NONE
  CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING MINUTES  Page 2 of 4  May 4, 2021
   ABSTAIN :  NONE
  ABSENT:  NONE

  A. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  The City Council approved the following:

  1. Minutes of the City Council Special Meeting of April 20, 2021 .
  2. Minutes of the City Council Regular Meeting of April 20, 2021 .

I
  3. Minutes of the City Council Special Meeting of April 27, 2021.

  B. MATERIAL DEMANDS

  The City Council approved the April 9, 2021, and April 16, 2021, Registers of
  Demands and Warrants for the payment of City expenditures.
  C. COUNTYWIDE HOUSEHOLD HAZARDOUS WASTE COLLECTION PROGRAM
  SITING LIABILITY AGREEMENT WITH LOS ANGELES COUNTY

  The City Council authorized the City Manager to execute the Countywide
  Household Hazardous Waste Collection Program Siting Liability Agreement.

  5. PUBLIC HEARING - None.

  6. CONTINUED BUSINESS - None.

  7. NEW BUSINESS

  A. UPDATE ON RETAIL LANDSCAPE IN SAN GABRIEL

I  Economic Development Manager Domenica Megerdichian made the staff
  presentation.

  There was no public comment.

  Discussion included the timeline for surveys of landlords, property owners and
  businesses; rideshare and outdoor dining effects on parking ratios; process for
  temporary and permanent outdoor dining permits; impact of COVI D-19 on taxable
  sales; commendation to staff for the report; assistance to current businesses;
  multilingual resource materials for businesses; and available grants.

  8. PUBLIC COMMENT - None.

  9. CITY MANAGER'S REPORT

  City Manager Lazzaretto thanked the San Gabriel Fire and Police Departments and
  outside agencies who assisted in fighting the San Gabriel Mission Fire last year and
  announced that the arson susp~ct is in custody.

I  10. COUNCIL COMMENTS AND CONFERENCE/MEETING REPORTS

  Council Member Pu requested a proclamation for Asian Pacific American Heritage
  Month for the next regular City Council meeting; and commented on services available
  through Compassion in SGV and announced an associated upcoming community
  event to be held on May 22, 2021 .

  Council Member Menchaca commented on the San Gabriel Mission fire investigation
  press conference.
  CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING MINUTES  Page 3 of 4  May 4, 2021
   Vice Mayor Ding commented on the San Gabriel Mission fire investigation press
  conference and on Asian American Heritage month.

  Council Member Harrington requested that an item be agendized for future City
  Council discussion regarding a vote of no confidence in the current Los Angeles
  County District Attorney and provided background information for his request.

  Mayor Liao agreed to Council Member Harrington's request; suggested the City

I  Council attend an upcoming San Gabriel Valley Economic Partnership event at which
  Los Angeles County District Attorney George Gascon will speak in order to better
  understand his position; commented on Los Angeles County's financial considerations
  related to incarceration; and commented on the press conference regarding the San
  Gabriel Mission fire investigation, San Gabriel Mission anniversary, and Walk to Los
  Angeles event.

  11. CLOSED SESSION - None.

  12. ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Liao adjourned the meeting at 8:36 P.M .

  Respectfully submitted :

I
  Approved this 18th day of May, 2021:

  CHIN HO LIAO, Mayor

I

  CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING MINUTES  Page 4 of 4  May 4, 2021
